tools.name: search_patients
tools.description: This tool allows you to search the patient directory by name, date of birth, or record number and return matching patient summaries.

tools.name: get_patient_record
tools.description: Retrieve the full clinical record for one patient by record number, including problem list, allergies, and recent encounters. Use this once you have a record number from search_patients.

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.description: Lists appointments for a patient or provider within a date range.

tools.name: schedule_appointment
tools.description: This tool allows you to schedule a new appointment for a patient with a provider at a given time. It creates an appointment record in the scheduling system.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled appointment and frees the provider's time slot. The appointment record is retained with a cancelled status for reporting.

tools.name: update_medication_list
tools.description: Updates the active medication list on a patient record by adding or removing entries. Records who made the change and when.
